subject: baku
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: baku, the dream-eating tapir spirit.
Style: ukiyo-e woodblock print.

spec.name: Baku, the Dream-Eater
spec.description: A great tapir spirit stands swallowing a glowing spiral of dream-mist that curls into its trunk, every surface a flat ukiyo-e colour field edged in ink with gold cloud trim.
spec.layout: A heavy, chunky tapir-spirit stands squarely on four short sturdy legs, front legs under the chest at z about +0.8 and hind legs under the rump at z about -0.8, cloven ivory hooves resting on y = 0 (only the legs part touches the floor). The barrel torso runs from chest z = +1.05 to rump z = -1.15, belly y about 0.6, back y about 1.5. The neck rises forward to a bold characterful head at z = +1.25: big almond eyes read from the front, a short curled elephantine trunk sweeps out and down from the face to the trunk tip at [0, 1.08, 1.98], an upper and lower jaw part so the mouth can open, two small bone tusks poke up from the lower jaw, and wide slab ears with pink inners and a gold flame-crest rise above the skull to y about 1.95. The style shows everywhere: the indigo coat is flat colour broken by a cream countershaded belly panel, cloud-spiral motifs (extruded teal-and-cream slabs with ink rims) are seated on the flanks and shoulder, every silhouette edge gets a thin dark ink part or ink-painted rim, and gold trim lines the hooves, crest and mane. Along the spine from neck to rump a mane of broad overlapping blades runs indigo-to-gold root to tip, and an ox-like tail drops from the rump ending in a gold-tipped tuft at z about -1.6. The signature: from the trunk tip a glowing spiral ribbon of dream-mist (mist white to mist blue, emissive) coils down and forward to z = +2.9, dotted with small star sparks, the dream being eaten.

parts.builds: The barrel body: one smooth loft over the spine joints from chest [0, 1.1, 1.05] to rump [0, 1.4, -1.1], widest at the belly (half width 0.45, belly y 0.6, back y 1.5), swept in indigo with a cream countershaded belly (sectors or a countershade paint). Details seated on it, each its own flat-coloured part: a cream belly panel edged with a thin ink sweep; three cloud-spiral motifs on the flanks and shoulder built as small extruded slabs of teal with cream spirals and ink rims, each placed on surface hits and sticking just out of the skin; a gold chest band swept as a loop round the chest just behind the forelegs mount; two small vermilion seal-like roundels on the rump flanks. Geometry rides the body joint (and neck for the shoulder area).
parts.attaches: Rises into neckBase toward the head part, meets shoulderLine and hipLine where the legs part hangs, and ends at rump where the mane and tail part takes over.

parts.builds: The head and trunk: a rounded skull (sphere or loft) on the head joint at skullCentre, faced forward, carrying the face. Big almond eyes that read from the front: white almond with ink outline and a dark teal pupil, one per side seated on the skull surface with an ink lid line; small gold brow strokes above. A short thick trunk built as a sweep along the trunk1-trunk2-trunk3 joints, tapering from 0.14 to 0.07 radius, indigo on top with a cream underside stripe, its tip flaring open with an ink inner ring; two nostril dots in ink at the tip. The upper jaw is part of the skull; the lower jaw hangs on the jaw joint as a smaller rounded frustum in indigoDeep with a vermilion tongue and cream gum line, built open a little. Two short ivory tusks curve up from the jaw sides (small tapering sweeps, horn colour). Wide slab ears (extruded rounded triangles, ink outline, blush inner, gold rim stud) splayed to each side above the eyes; a gold flame-crest of three tapered blade extrudes rises from the forehead between the ears. Ends exactly at trunkTip where the dream swirl enters.
parts.attaches: Skull sits on neckBase through the neck joint; trunk tip ends at mount trunkTip.

parts.builds: Four short sturdy pillar legs, one sweep tube per leg through hip, knee and ankle joints (radius 0.13 tapering to 0.09), indigo with a cream front stripe and an ink knee cap seated on each knee; joints bent to the given coordinates so the stance reads stable. Each foot is a cloven hoof on the toe joint: two chunky half-hoof extrudes in horn with an ink cleft and a gold band round the pastern, the hoof bottoms flat at y = 0. Small ink toe seams at the hoof fronts. All four legs share construction; mirror x for the right pair.
parts.attaches: Front pair hangs from shoulderLine, back pair from hipLine, each hip joint socketed into the torso underside.

parts.builds: The spine crest and tail: a mane of broad overlapping blades running along the spine from the back of the ears down to the rump (about 10 blades, each an extrude slab in the root-to-tip palette indigoDeep to gold, alternating heights, leaning back), rooted on surface hits along the spineCrest line. The tail hangs from rump as a sweep through tail1-tail2-tail3, thick at the root (0.08) and thinning, indigoDeep, ending in a tuft of 5-6 hanging tapered spikes in gold with cream tips at z about -1.6. Two or three small cloud-spiral slabs (teal and cream with ink rims, matching the torso motifs) float-stick beside the tail root so the spirit's back reads as one painted scroll.
parts.attaches: Mane roots along spineCrest on the torso back; tail roots at rump; the front of the mane box meets the head part's ears at the neck top.

parts.builds: The dream being eaten: a spiral ribbon of glowing mist rising out of the air in front of the trunk and threading into trunkTip. Built as two or three open spiral paths swept as thin flat ribbons (width 0.05-0.09, radius function tapering to a point), in mist white and mist blue, glowing via the glow kit at strength 1.2-1.5, with a fainter inner second spiral offset in phase. A dozen small star sparks (tiny four-point extrude slabs or octahedron parts) in white and gold, also glowing, scattered along the spiral with fixed rng; one slightly larger crescent-shaped wisp (extrude, mist) near the outer end of the spiral suggests a half-swallowed dream. The spiral starts in the air at about [0.15, 0.6, 2.7] and its inner end seats exactly into mount trunkTip, slightly embedded in the trunk opening. Nothing here touches the floor.
parts.attaches: Inner end of every ribbon seats at mount trunkTip on the head part's trunk3 joint; the rest floats free in front of and above the face.

calls.reasoning:
I need to write a spec for a baku — a dream-eating tapir spirit in ukiyo-e woodblock print style. Teams build parts: 3-6 parts. Creature: tapir-like spirit with trunk-like snout, cloven feet, mane, cloud motifs, maybe eating a dream (swirl of smoke/mist).

Plan the model:
- Baku standing on four legs, body length ~1.4m for a spirit... Real tapir is ~2m long. Style: ukiyo-e — flat colours, ink outlines, indigo/cream/palette, gold cloud trim, moon motif. A crescent moon overhead? Dream-swirl being eaten from snout — a spiral ribbon of mist entering the trunk. That's the wow.

Size: width ~0.9, height ~1.8 (with mane/crest), length ~2.6. Baku traditionally has lion-like features, elephant trunk, ox tail. Let's keep tapir-ish body with short trunk, tusks maybe, cloud-pattern mane.

Parts (5-6):
1. torso (body + cloud-painted flank, belly) — box spanning body.
2. head (skull, trunk as separate chain with joints, jaw, tusks, eyes, ears) — head sits front at +Z.
3. legs (four legs, each a chain, cloven hooves).
4. tail (ox-like tufted tail) + mane/crest along spine.
5. dream-swirl (glowing spiral ribbon of mist entering the trunk) + maybe crescent moon? Or swirl alone.
6. Could combine mane+tail into one "spirit trim" part.

Layout: front at +Z. Body length ~2.4. Head at z ≈ +1.2, trunk extends to z ≈ +1.5. Rump at z ≈ -1.2.

Joints skeleton:
- root "body" (spine) at [0, 1.05, -0.1]
- neck, head, jaw, trunk joints (trunk2, trunk3), ears? ears can be static parts on head.
- legs: legFL chain: hipFL, kneeFL, ankleFL/footFL (leg role). Legs as chains with 3 joints each: shoulder/knee/ankle + tip? Chain with names ["hipFL","kneeFL","ankleFL","footFL"]? Spec lists joints individually in skeleton; parts reference them.

Since builders each write functions into a shared builder, joints must be pre-declared in spec order so parts share them. But chain/sprout builders create joints dynamically... The spec's `joints` array is created before parts run. I'll list all joints explicitly with parents.

Leg chain: hip, knee, ankle, toe. Four legs × 4 joints = 16 joints. Plus spine, neck, head, jaw, trunk (3), tail (3), maybe mane joints. Keep manageable.

Legs: standing height ~1.0 at belly, feet on y=0. Use limb-style positions: hip at [±0.42, 1.05, 0.7], knee at [±0.46, 0.6, 0.75], ankle at [±0.44, 0.3, 0.62], toe at [±0.44, 0.0, 0.72]. Actually let me simplify: front legs at z≈0.85, back legs at z≈-0.85, body belly at y≈0.85, back top y≈1.45.

Height ~1.8 max (ears/mane). Width ~1.1. Length: trunk tip z=1.95 to tail tuft z=-1.6 → ~3.6 total. Size [1.1, 1.9, 3.6].

Dream-swirl: spiral ribbon entering trunk tip, glowing pale cyan/white — "dream mist". Plus a crescent moon disc behind? Moon is scenery; brief says dream-eating spirit — swirl is the subject's signature. Put swirl part budget ~120 with spiral ribbons, little sleeping-face wisps? Keep swirl: a spiral path swept with gradient, glow, small star sparks.

Parts:
1. "torso" — loft body over spine, cloud-pattern flank (mottle/spots? ukiyo-e cloud bands as painted? Better: small parts — but budget...). Use paint bands? Spec says every surface flat colour, details as parts. But paint kit is allowed? The spec format is generic; palette of flat colours. The builders get the system prompt (which includes paint kits). I can instruct: cloud swirl motifs as extruded flat pieces seated on the flank, plus countershade belly piece. Keep as: body loft in indigo-grey, belly panel cream, flank clouds as 3-4 small extrude slabs in cream + gold outline.

Budget 200.

3. "legs" — four legs, chain sweeps, hooves cloven (two extrude toes), knee caps. Budget 160.

4. "mane and tail" — dorsal mane of broad blades along spine (root-to-tip palette: indigo → gold), ox tail with tuft, back crest flame. Budget 140.
